symptomShortText: Coolant leak at sealing surface reported by customer

causesIshikawa.description: EMP-1187, Shift A - casting operator, no deviation logged
EQ-CAST03-001, die temperature within band all shift
DOC-3308 Rev D - die casting parameter sheet, unchanged
Ingot lot ING-77412 hydrogen content 0.38 ppm vs max 0.20 ppm - degassing certificate accepted without re-test

fiveWhyChain.question: Why did the housing leak at the sealing surface?
fiveWhyChain.answer: Porosity area ratio measured 3.8% vs max 1.0% spec - gas pores broke through the machined sealing face

fiveWhyChain.question: Why was porosity so high in this batch?
fiveWhyChain.answer: Ingot lot ING-77412 carried 0.38 ppm hydrogen against a 0.20 ppm limit, so gas came out of solution during solidification

fiveWhyChain.question: Why did the out-of-spec ingot reach the casting line? (root cause)
fiveWhyChain.answer: Incoming inspection accepted the supplier degassing certificate without an independent hydrogen re-test, so the deviation was never detected

actions.actionText: Block remaining stock from batch B-50231 and 100% helium leak test all P90 housings before dispatch
Notify customer plant Valencia and sort 46 units already delivered
Reject and return ingot lot ING-77412 to supplier; release replacement lot ING-77455 after hydrogen re-test
Add mandatory hydrogen content re-test to the incoming inspection plan for all aluminium ingot lots, independent of supplier certificate

fmeaLink.description: Gas porosity from incoming ingot hydrogen content

lessonsLearned.whatWorked: Batch traceability tied every failed unit back to a single ingot lot within two days
lessonsLearned.whatDidnt: Supplier certificates were trusted without verification - the control existed only on paper

isIsNot.isWhereWhenItHappens: P90 sealing face - WC-CAST-03 - castings poured from ingot lot ING-77412 between 2026-06-24 and 2026-06-26
isIsNot.isNotWhereWhenItDoesnt: P70 / P110 variants - WC-CAST-01 - castings from ingot lots ING-77380 and ING-77455
isIsNot.notes: Defect tracks the ingot lot, not the machine or the shift
